changelog: Phase 1: Stuck-Chat Deadlock Fix & Fail-Safe Execution: Injected non-interactive git environment flags (GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, GIT_ASKPASS=/bin/true, GIT_SSH_COMMAND non-interactive batch mode) across Termux, PRoot, and SSH; added 300s fail-safe process timeouts to live shell executions

Stuck Turn Recovery & Force Reset: Fixed bug where hung subprocesses left conversations permanently busy; added forceResetRunningState() and quick 'Force Reset' in confirmation dialogs so conversations can never become permanently bricked
Clean Cloned Repo Workspaces: Git cloning now seamlessly initializes a clean workspace in a fresh conversation (startNewChatInWorkspace) instead of mutating in-flight chats

Phase 2: GitHub Copilot Agent Integration: Added GitHub Copilot as a first-class agent alongside Antigravity and Claude Code with GitHub Device Code flow (https://github.com/login/device) and Personal Access Token (PAT) authentication

Copilot Models & Gravent Persona: Access Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, o3-mini, o1, and Gemini 2.0 Flash directly with your Copilot subscription; custom Gravent agent persona with full awareness of the Android and Termux environment
Authenticated GitHub Repo Cloning: Connected GitHub accounts enable 1-tap cloning of both public and private repositories with zero terminal credential prompts
